description: Thirty deterministic Python maintenance tasks. Hidden tests are materialized only after the agent run.

tasks.title: Clamp respects upper bound
tasks.task: Fix clamp(value, minimum, maximum): values above maximum currently return minimum. Preserve the public API.
acceptance: clamp handles below, inside, and above ranges

tasks.title: Normalize email whitespace
tasks.task: Fix normalize_email so surrounding whitespace is removed before case normalization.

tasks.title: Safe mean for generators
tasks.task: Fix mean so it accepts one-shot iterables without consuming them twice and raises ValueError for empty input.

tasks.title: Boolean parser false values
tasks.task: Fix parse_bool so common false strings return False instead of True and unknown values raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Sequence chunking
tasks.task: Implement chunked(items, size) returning consecutive lists. Reject non-positive sizes.

tasks.title: Stable unique values
tasks.task: Implement unique(items) with stable order and support for unhashable values.

tasks.title: Nested dictionary lookup
tasks.task: Implement get_in(mapping, dotted_path, default=None) without mutating input.

tasks.title: Retry delay schedule
tasks.task: Implement retry_delays(attempts, base=1.0, cap=60.0) using capped exponential backoff and validate arguments.

tasks.title: Extract slug normalization
tasks.task: Refactor slugify into small private helpers without changing observable behavior. Remove duplicated separator cleanup.

tasks.title: Remove mutable default
tasks.task: Refactor collect_errors to remove shared mutable default state while preserving its return type.

tasks.title: Dataclass serialization
tasks.task: Refactor User.to_dict to avoid duplicated field mapping and keep password_hash excluded.

tasks.title: Centralize status labels
tasks.task: Refactor status_label to use one declarative mapping and preserve the fallback for unknown codes.

tasks.title: Add boundary tests for clamp
tasks.task: Add focused tests for clamp boundary values and inverted ranges. Fix implementation only if the new tests reveal a defect.

tasks.title: Add parser table tests
tasks.task: Add parameterized tests for parse_port covering valid boundaries, malformed text, and out-of-range values.
acceptance: new tests cover boundaries and errors

tasks.title: Add cache expiry tests
tasks.task: Add deterministic tests for TTLCache expiry using its injected clock; do not sleep.

tasks.title: Add redaction tests
tasks.task: Add tests proving redact removes nested password, token, and api_key values without mutating input.

tasks.title: Keyword-only timeout
tasks.task: Change request(url, timeout) so timeout is keyword-only with a 5.0 default. Update call sites and tests.

tasks.title: Structured pagination result
tasks.task: Change paginate to return a Page object with items, page, page_size, and total while retaining iteration over items.

tasks.title: Rename user identifier
tasks.task: Rename create_user(name) parameter to username and accept legacy name only as a deprecated keyword alias; reject both together.

tasks.title: Result error contract
tasks.task: Change divide to return a Result object instead of None on division by zero, with ok/value/error fields.

tasks.title: Validate host ports
tasks.task: Harden parse_host_port for missing hosts, nonnumeric ports, IPv6 bracket notation, and port range 1..65535.

tasks.title: Validate usernames
tasks.task: Implement validate_username: 3-32 characters, ASCII letters/digits/underscore, starting with a letter.

tasks.title: Reject unsafe archive paths
tasks.task: Implement is_safe_archive_path to reject absolute paths, traversal, drive prefixes, and backslash traversal.

tasks.title: Strict ISO dates
tasks.task: Fix parse_date to accept only real YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates with zero-padded components.

tasks.title: Linear duplicate detection
tasks.task: Optimize first_duplicate from quadratic to expected linear time while preserving support for hashable values.

tasks.title: Avoid repeated regex compilation
tasks.task: Optimize extract_tags so its regular expression is compiled once, not on every call. Preserve results.

tasks.title: Streaming line count
tasks.task: Refactor count_nonempty_lines to stream from a file-like iterable without materializing all lines.

tasks.title: Environment precedence
tasks.task: Fix load_config precedence to defaults < config mapping < ADEV_ environment, with integer conversion for PORT.

tasks.title: Logging level validation
tasks.task: Implement configure_logging(level) with case-insensitive standard levels and reject unknown levels.

tasks.title: Feature flag parsing
tasks.task: Fix feature_enabled to parse explicit true/false environment values and use the supplied default when unset.
